```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
hotel <- read_csv("data/hotel_saved.csv")
glimpse(hotel)
```

```{r data_summary, include=TRUE}
summary(hotel)
```
```{r data_cleaning1a, include=TRUE}
hotel_clean <- select(hotel, hotel, lead_time, is_canceled)
glimpse(hotel_clean)
```
```{r data_cleaning1b, include=TRUE}
hotel_clean %>%
  filter(is.na(hotel) | is.na(lead_time) | is.na(is_canceled))
```
```{r cancellation_rate, include=TRUE}
hotel_clean %>%
  group_by(hotel) %>%
  summarise(
    cancellation_rate = mean(is_canceled)
  )
```
```{r visualisation, include=TRUE}
hotel_rate <- hotel_clean %>%
  group_by(hotel) %>%
  summarise(
    cancellation_rate = mean(is_canceled)
  )

ggplot(hotel_rate, aes(x = hotel, y = cancellation_rate)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Cancellation Rate by Hotel Type",
    x = "Hotel Type",
    y = "Cancellation Rate"
  )
```

```{r data_group, include=TRUE}
hotel_clean <- hotel_clean %>%
  mutate(
    lead_time_group = cut(
      lead_time,
      breaks = c(0, 30, 90, 180, 365, Inf),
      labels = c("0-30", "31-90", "91-180", "181-365", "365+")
    )
  )
```

```{r data_calculate, include=TRUE}
lead_time_rate <- hotel_clean %>%
  group_by(lead_time_group) %>%
  summarise(
    cancellation_rate = mean(is_canceled)
  )
lead_time_rate
```

```{r data_visualisation2, include=TRUE}
ggplot(lead_time_rate, aes(x = lead_time_group, y = cancellation_rate)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Cancellation Rate by Lead Time",
    x = "Lead Time (Days)",
    y = "Cancellation Rate"
  )
```
```{r data_select, include=TRUE}
deposit_data <- hotel %>%
  select(deposit_type, is_canceled)
```

```{r data_count, include=TRUE}
count(deposit_data, deposit_type)
```

```{r data_calculation3, include=TRUE}
deposit_rate <- deposit_data %>%
  group_by(deposit_type) %>%
  summarise(
    cancellation_rate = mean(is_canceled)
  )

deposit_rate
```

```{r data_visualisation3, include=TRUE}
ggplot(deposit_rate, aes(x = deposit_type, y = cancellation_rate)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Cancellation Rate by Deposit Type",
    x = "Deposit Type",
    y = "Cancellation Rate"
  )
```
